failure.message: hang-no-timeout: Arm TimerTimeout(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, _NTO_TIMEOUT_SEND|_NTO_TIMEOUT_REPLY, ...) before MsgSend and handle ETIMEDOUT.
starved: The client runs below background load. Give the critical loop a priority above it (e.g. `on -p 61 <cmd>` or pthread_setschedparam) or use adaptive partitioning.
server-not-restarted: Supervise the server (e.g. a watchdog or the System Launch and Monitor) so it is restarted after it dies.
slow-intolerant: Arm TimerTimeout before each request to a server that can be slow; a live server honours the unblock, so the client gets ETIMEDOUT and carries on.
hang-no-timeout: Arm TimerTimeout(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, _NTO_TIMEOUT_SEND|_NTO_TIMEOUT_REPLY, ...) before MsgSend and handle ETIMEDOUT.
